# CANDIDATE: VIX_MEAN_REVERSION_RIBBON_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extreme intraday VIX spikes often precede a short‑term mean‑reversion move opposite to the immediate price bias, especially when the ribbon is aligned. The VIX spike reflects heightened fear/uncertainty that tends to revert, while the ribbon alignment confirms the underlying bias for the mean-reversion trade.

## Mechanism

Entry: When VIX > 1.8 × 20-period EMA of VIX AND price > VWAP + 0.2% (short signal) OR price < VWAP - 0.2% (long signal) AND ribbon shows opposite bias (EMA stack sloping down for short, up for long), enter at close of that bar opposite to price-VWAP deviation.  
Exit: Stop at nearest recent swing point invalidating mean-reversion (prior HH for shorts, prior HL for longs) or 0.5% adverse move; target at 1× ATR(10) or exit when VIX < 20-period EMA.  
Regime: Active 10:00-11:30 EST; avoid first 15 min and last 30 min of session.
